about.title: Ice cream that remembers.
about.body:
Smriti means memory, and that is what every scoop is made to bring back: the first mango of summer, the kulfi at a family wedding, the chocolate you shared on the way home.

Everything here is made by hand, one flavour at a time. Order what you love, and let {brandName} turn it into your next good memory.
